news.title: Home Office issues amendment after The PIE reports on BCA blind spot
news.summary_en: The Home Office has published an amendment to the student sponsor compliance policy, clarifying that only visa refusal decisions that are successfully overturned by administrative review will be exempt from BCA calculations.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: Barney Glover appointed inaugural chief commissioner of Australia’s tertiary watchdog
news.summary_en: Australia's new tertiary education watchdog is beginning to take shape, with former university leader Barney Glover appointed inaugural chief commissioner, alongside three statutory commissioners tasked with driving major sector reforms.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: US sector hails growing congressional support despite headwinds
news.summary_en: While strong policy headwinds remain, US experts have welcomed signs of a gradual shift in Washington DC as Congress increasingly stands up for international education.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: New UKVI compliance metrics for universities take effect today
news.summary_en: Highly anticipated and controversial new compliance requirements for UK universities come into force today, with immigration specialists warning the measures could have "potentially devastating consequences" for institutions that fail to meet increasingly stringent benchmarks.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: New Zealand confirms November rollout of graduate work visa
news.summary_en: The new six-month visa and expanded post-study work rights for some graduate diploma holders will take effect from November 16 under New Zealand's wider international education growth strategy.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK: sustained junior ELT demand despite geopolitical hurdles
news.summary_en: The English language teaching (ELT) sector in the UK is seeing a fall in student weeks, but demand from the junior market remains resilient as economic and geopolitical headwinds take effect.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Latest updates from NAFSA 2026
news.summary_en: Missed NAFSA 2026 this year? Join The PIE's senior reporter Polly Nash for a whistlestop tour through all the major talking points from the conference.
news.author: Polly Nash
